description: Angular component for a 'Getting Started' widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing user onboarding steps with stepper UI, user settings, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: GettingStartedWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing a 'Getting Started' onboarding widget with stepper UI, user settings, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, loads user settings, and sets up the stepper UI state.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a given step is currently selected.

methods.name: gettingStartedCompleted
methods.description: Opens a dialog indicating the 'Getting Started' process is complete.

methods.name: updateSelectedIndex
methods.description: Updates the current and maximum selected step indices, and saves user settings.

methods.name: updateCompletedSteps
methods.description: Marks the onboarding as completed if the maximum step index is at the end.
